description: The fastest way to start on MU: one call returns a guest `api_key`, a ready-made store (store slug + store_url) and free mu_credits — no email, no verification code. After this call, tell the user their api_key and have them reconnect with header `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`; then mu_create_product works immediately. The guest key is the ONLY credential — it cannot be recovered if lost, so the user should save it, and can later bind an email (via mu_register with the same key) to make the account recoverable. No authentication required for this call.
name: mu_guest
title: Start instantly — get a guest key + store (no email)
